en.title: The Smoldering Tome and the Spiral Fault
en.premise: In the lowest depths of the city, beneath soot‑blackened alleys, a former engine mechanic who now runs a second‑hand bookshop acquires a strange clockwork volume titled "Memories of Past Abundance." The book is a device that transports its reader into a temporal distortion leading to the fabled "Golden Age of Industry"—a period of such prosperity it once cloaked the sky, but vanished abruptly when atmospheric steam pressure went awry. Seeking the lost technologies and the fevered chronicles of that civilization, the man boards a rusted steam airship and sets sail toward the fault in history.

zh.title: 煤烟的古书与螺旋断层
zh.premise: 在城市的最底层，沾满煤烟的巷弄里，经营古书店的前机工男子某日得到一本奇异的发条书——《过去丰饶的记忆》。这本书实际上是一件装置，能够将读者引入时间的裂缝，前往传说中的"黄金产业时代"——曾经繁荣到几乎遮蔽天空，却因大气蒸汽压失调而骤然消失的时代。为了寻找失落的技术与记录文明狂热的篇章，男子登上锈迹斑斑的蒸汽飞艇，驶向历史的断层。
